connector.name: Xitoring
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to Xitoring monitoring: servers, uptime, incidents, metrics, SSL, and alerts.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.xitoring.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xitoring account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for the Xitoring API. Generate at Dashboard > Account > API Access.
